verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of retention settings, auto-delete schedules, or user-controlled deletion of recordings or transcripts. The closest items are adjacent: an enterprise opt-out from AI model training (otter-docs-43), audit trails, and a community member mentioning they deleted their account. None of these shows a retention or deletion control. A community report that recordings are retained in the cloud describes retention, not user control over it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
